instagram.caption:
How I clean my room with ADHD (when I can't even start) 🧹

"Clean my room" isn't one task. It's 40 tasks in a trench coat. Here's the 3-step trick that finally got me unstuck:

1. Break it into tiny steps (step 1 took me 3 minutes)
2. Put ONE step on screen, start a timer, turn on calm sounds
3. When the timer ends, you're allowed to stop. You probably won't.

22 minutes later, the room I avoided for 3 weeks was done.

📌 Save this for your next frozen day, and send it to someone who needs it.
💜 The app I use for the steps + timer is FOCO, link in bio.
